# scripts/ops/Publish-AvdSandboxResult.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Publishes the results of a finished sandbox batch group to the private companion queue and back to the initiating repository issues (docs/sandbox-runs.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-BatchId` | string | yes |  | Batch ID to report (for example, b20261021-1700). |
| `-Group` | string | yes |  | Group ID within the batch (for example, G1). |
| `-RecordsPath` | string | no |  | Local records cache folder; defaults to ~/clouddrive/avd-runs or ~/avd-runs. |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  | Sandbox subscription ID for the run store. |
| `-PrivateRepo` | string | no | `$env:AVD_PRIVATE_REPO` | Private companion repository (owner/repo) holding the sandbox-run queue issues. |
| `-Local` | switch | no |  | Read and write records on this disk only without syncing the Azure run store. |
| `-CloseInitiatingIssue` | switch | no |  | Also close the initiating repository issue when its verification test passed. |
| `-OutPath` | string | no |  | Optional file path to write the generated result report JSON. |
| `-Force` | switch | no |  | Publish again even if results-<Group>.json already records reportedAt. |
| `-DryRun` | switch | no |  | Build and print the report without calling GitHub. |
